jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Architus is collaborating with Tide, a growing leader in banking technology, on strategic projects, and we are looking for a Engineering Manager to join their innovative team.

About Tide

Tide recently established a branch in Lithuania, currently home to 45+ engineers, with plans for significant expansion. Tide is building an innovative finance platform designed to help small businesses save both time and money. In addition to providing business accounts and banking services, Tide offers a comprehensive suite of connected administrative solutions, ranging from invoicing to accounting.

Launched in 2017, Tide is now trusted by over 1,8 million small businesses worldwide and is available to SMEs in the UK, India, France and Germany.

As Tide continues to grow rapidly and expand into new markets, the company is always seeking passionate and driven teammates. Join Tide in its mission to empower small businesses and help them save time and money.

The Opportunity

As an Engineering Manager at Tide, you will be responsible for building and running the products your team owns, covering everything our members need to run their business, from banking and payments through to administration and operational tooling.

This role offers an exceptional opportunity to make a real difference by taking ownership of engineering practices in a rapidly expanding company! We trust and empower our Engineering Managers to make real architectural decisions that affect their domain and shape the future of Tide’s Platform.

We operate in domain-aligned, full-stack teams that own products end to end. Engineers self-organise, collaborate on technical challenges, and define shared standards through Communities of Practice.

  • Leading & Directly managing a cross functional team
  • Partnering with a Product Manager to form the Product Engineering Duo
  • Deeply caring about what’s being built as much as the how
  • Being responsible of the delivery of the team - quality, stability, timelines, dependencies
  • Being responsible of the tech excellence and architecture within the scope of the team
  • Driving the continuous improvement of the team performance as measured by DORA
  • Securing the continuous growth and wellbeing of the engineers on their team
  • Being hands-on, carefully dividing your time between design, coding and coaching other team members. You will be the person people turn to seeking advice and solutions to difficult problems.

Requirements

  • Extensive experience building server-side applications and detailed knowledge of Java
  • Sound knowledge of a backend framework (e.g. Spring/Spring Boot) 
  • Experience with running microservices and implementing and consuming RESTful APIs
  • Experience engineering scalable and reliable solutions in a cloud-native environment 
  • A mindset of delivering secure, well-tested and well-documented software 
  • Full ownership of your code and technical solutions across their entire lifecycle, from development to production.
  • Experience integrating with various third party providers and partners 
  • Sound knowledge and experience working with relational databases
  • Work effectively in an agile environment, using its practices to deliver value consistently and adapt quickly
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to a non-technical audience 
  • Apply continuous integration, delivery, and deployment practices in day-to-day development to deliver software reliably to production
  • A technical hands on leader who is in the details of what the team is working on day to day
  • Experience  leading teams
  • Experience directly managing people

Technical Stack

  • Java, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices (but we welcome people who are used to any strongly typed general purpose programming language!) 
  • Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable 
  • Primary datastores are PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users) 
  • Docker, Terraform, ArgoCD and, EKS provided by the Cloud team to run the platform 
  • DataDog for monitoring, observability and automated SLOs
  • GitHub, Semgrep and solid testing to power the CI/CD pipelines - new joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first week 
  • Angular on Web, Flutter for our mobile app, but from time to time we use Swift and Kotlin
  • Fivetran/BigQuery/Looker for the BI insights and Python/FastAPI/Faust + some ML libs for the automated decisioning and risk management.

What You’ll Get in Return

Make work, work for you! We are embracing new ways of working and support flexible working arrangements. With our Working Out of Office (WOO) policy our colleagues can work remotely from home or anywhere in their home country. Additionally, you can work from a different country for up to 90 days a year. Plus, you’ll get:

  • The gross monthly salary for this position ranges from €7.400 to €11.560 gross, depending on your skills, and experience. But we are also open to discussing the salary further, taking into account your expertise and contributions.
  • Flexible workplacemodel thatsupports both in-person and remote work.
  • Additional health insurance.
  • 5 extra vacation days.
  • 3 paid days off for volunteering or L&D activities.
  • Parental Leave days.
  • Family-Friendly Leave.
  • Personal L&D budget in the amount of 500 EUR per year.
  • Mental wellbeing platform Plumm.
  • WFH equipment allowance.
  • Sabbatical Leave.
  • Share options.
  • Team Events.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer (Data & Analytics Consulting)
jobs.description:
Architus specialises in connecting leading UK and US businesses with top EU engineering talent, helping to build high-performing technology teams and establish a presence overseas. With offices in London, Vilnius and Kaunas, Architus has a strong track record and an impressive list of clients such as Invesco, Tide, Capital Group, Schroders, BNP Paribas, and HSBC.


The Opportunity

Architus is partnering with the data and analytics practice of a prestigious global management consultancy. Their teams build data platforms, pipelines and analytical models for some of the world's largest financial services institutions, including Hedge Funds and Investment Banks.

We are building a team of versatile data engineers in Lithuania to join their Data and Analytics group. You will work side by side with data scientists and business stakeholders on exciting international projects that are delivered at pace. Projects typically run for six to nine months, so you will see different industries, problems and tech stacks instead of maintaining one system for years.

This is a role for an engineer who enjoys variety, likes to understand the business problem behind the data, and is as comfortable writing solid software as building a pipeline.


About the role

  • Design and build data pipelines that bring data from internal and external sources into client data platforms.
  • Build and maintain data-intensive applications and data products that support advanced analytics and modelling.
  • Solve data matching, reconciliation and entity resolution problems across multiple data sources.
  • Test, monitor and troubleshoot what you build, and keep improving data quality and reliability.
  • Work closely with data scientists and consultants to turn business questions into working, production-grade solutions.
  • Apply good software engineering practice: clean code, code review, version control, CI/CD and infrastructure as code.
  • Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical people, including client teams.
  • Pick up new tools and domains quickly as you move between projects.


What we are looking for

  • Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining data pipelines or data-heavy systems in a Data Engineer or Software Engineer role.
  • Strong Python and SQL, with a focus on clean, performant code that handles large volumes of data.
  • A track record of designing and building data pipelines and data-intensive applications, with an open mind about tools.
  • Experience with some of the following:
    – distributed data processing such as Spark and Databricks
    – a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP)
    – orchestration tools such as Airflow
    – CI/CD and infrastructure as code
  • Solid software engineering fundamentals. You can build a service or a library, not only a transformation job.
  • A habit of testing your work and a record of improving data reliability and quality.
  • Excellent spoken and written English, and the confidence to explain your thinking to clients and colleagues.
  • Ownership, curiosity and the drive to solve hard problems quickly.
  • A degree in Computer Science or another quantitative field.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with data matching, reconciliation or entity resolution.
  • Background in financial services, risk management or consulting.
  • Experience working in project-based or client-facing teams.


What you’ll get in return

  • Salary: Starting from €7000 gross/month, depending on your experience (full-time only).
  • Variety: High-impact projects across industries, alongside exceptionally talented people.
  • Career Growth: Accelerate your professional journey by working with modern data technologies in a truly global environment.
  • Holidays: Enjoy extra vacation days to recharge and unwind.
  • Flexibility: Benefit from hybrid working options for a healthy work-life balance.
  • Workplace: A modern, pet-friendly office equipped with parking and plenty of snacks to keep you fueled and productive.
  • Team Environment: A dynamic, collaborative, and friendly working atmosphere.
  • Perks: Stay balanced with our wellness program, enjoy additional health insurance, plan for the future with 3rd-pillar pension benefits, and perform at your best with high-spec hardware.


Ready to Join Us?

If you're enthusiastic about this opportunity and believe you're the right fit, we'd love to hear from you! Apply now and let's create something amazing together. We look forward to meeting the next Architus star!

The Opportunity

Architus is partnering with a leading UK energy company to help build a significant presence in Lithuania. With a reputation for innovation, the company is tackling some of the world’s most pressing problems by creating better energy systems for the planet and for everyone on it.

This is an exciting time to join, as the company is expanding and offers numerous opportunities for professional development. You will be part of a passionate team dedicated to making a tangible difference in the world through cutting-edge technology, all driven by a dynamic and entrepreneurial spirit.

About the team

You will be joining a team that is part of the largest strategic transformation in the companies history, developing greenfield target state technology and innovative solutions for over 4 million customers.

You will be part of an autonomous Product team grouped with several other teams under a common Fintech domain which includes Energy Trading, Payments and Exports. You will be working alongside teammates in Lithuania, while also collaborating with colleagues in the UK.

As a back end engineer you will be helping to build API-first services that form part of a new target architecture. You will have the opportunity to contribute towards the design, built and scaling of customer products and services, collaborating with other Product and Engineering teams.

Requirements

jobs.title: Senior SRE Engineer
jobs.description:
Architus specialises in connecting leading UK and US businesses with top EU engineering talent, helping them build high-performing technology teams and establish a presence overseas. With offices in London, Vilnius and Kaunas, Architus has a strong track record and an impressive list of clients, including Invesco, Tide, Capital Group, Schroders, BNP Paribas, and HSBC.

The Opportunity

Architus is partnering with a leading UK energy company to help build a significant presence in Lithuania. With a reputation for innovation, the company is tackling some of the world’s most pressing challenges by creating better energy systems for the planet and everyone on it.

This is an exciting time to join the company as it continues to expand, offering numerous opportunities for professional development. You will be part of a passionate team dedicated to making a tangible difference in the world through cutting-edge technology, driven by a dynamic and entrepreneurial spirit.


About the Role

Site Reliability Engineering is at the heart of the company's customer-focused technology transformation, building and maintaining scalable, efficient, and reliable platforms for the company's applications and services. The goal of Site Reliability Engineering is to enhance the reliability, performance, and cost-efficiency of the systems, enabling teams to confidently deliver robust services in GCP. This focus on smart and efficient usage of cloud services also contributes to reducing CO2 usage, supporting the energy company's sustainability goals.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design, maintain and automate monitoring, alerting and observability solutions using tools such as Datadog, Prometheus and Grafana.
  • Define and monitor SLIs/SLOs, improve incident response processes, and support on-call operations.
  • Lead or support the resolution of production incidents, conduct blameless post-mortems, and drive continuous reliability improvements.
  • Optimise cloud infrastructure costs while maintaining performance, scalability and reliability.
  • Support capacity planning, performance tuning and resilience initiatives through monitoring and load testing insights.
  • Collaborate with engineering, QA, security and product teams to embed Site Reliability Engineering best practices.
  • Contribute to system design reviews with a focus on reliability, scalability and operational excellence.
  • Share knowledge, mentor colleagues and actively contribute to the Site Reliability Engineering Community of Practice.


Requirements

  • Professional software engineering experience with Python, TypeScript, Go, Java or similar, applying best practices such as CI/CD, testing and code reviews.
  • Hands-on experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure) and a solid understanding of cloud-native infrastructure, networking, storage and distributed systems.
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Pulumi or Crossplane.
  • Data-driven approach to engineering, using metrics, logs, SLIs/SLOs and error budgets to improve system reliability.
  • Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills across Linux, networking and distributed systems.
  • Passion for mentoring others and promoting Site Reliability Engineering best practices.
  • Experience with capacity planning, performance tuning and cloud cost optimisation, with an automation-first mindset.

What You’ll Get in Return

  • Salary: Starting from €7000 gross/month, depending on your experience (full-time only).
  • Career Growth: Accelerate your professional journey by working with cutting-edge technologies in a truly global environment.
  • Holidays: Enjoy extra vacation days to recharge and unwind.
  • Flexibility: Benefit from hybrid working options for a healthy work-life balance.
  • Workplace: A modern, pet-friendly office equipped with parking and plenty of snacks to keep you fueled and productive.
  • Work Abroad: Enjoy the flexibility to work remotely from another EU country for up to 30 days per year.
  • High-Spec Hardware: Brand-new, high-performance equipment provided to support your work from day one.
  • Team Environment: A dynamic, collaborative, and friendly working atmosphere.
  • Perks: Enjoy additional health insurance, plan for the future with 3rd-pillar pension benefits, and perform at your best with high-spec hardware.

Ready to Join Us?

If you’re excited about this opportunity and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you!

Apply now and let’s create something amazing together. We look forward to meeting the next Architus star!

jobs.title: Senior/Lead QA Engineer
jobs.description:
Architus specialises in connecting leading UK and US businesses with top EU engineering talent, helping build high-performing technology teams and establish presence overseas. With offices in London and Vilnius, Architus has a strong track-record and impressive list of clients such as Invesco, Tide, Capital Group, Schroders, BNP Paribas, and HSBC.

The Opportunity


We are partnering with a leading global digital investor communications platform that provides Proxy Voting and Shareholder Disclosure services to financial institutions worldwide. Originally developed within a major financial institution, the platform is transforming capital markets through innovative, secure, and compliant technology solutions.

We are looking for an experienced Senior / Lead QA Engineer to own quality across complex software delivery projects and play a key role in ensuring the quality, stability, and reliability of a mission-critical financial platform.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who thrives in fast-paced delivery environments, has exceptional attention to detail, and enjoys working closely with Product, Operations, and Engineering teams.You will take ownership of end-to-end quality across complex releases, shape requirements from a testability perspective, define test strategies, validate business-critical workflows, challenge the effectiveness of automated testing, and help drive continuous improvements to QA practices.

In this model the QA Engineer is a peer of the Software Engineer and the Product Manager, not a downstream tester. They shape the specification so that it can be tested, set the test strategy, challenge whether the automated tests prove the requirements, and give the final testing sign-off before release.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the overall quality approach across new feature development, enhancements, and platform releases, combining manual, exploratory, API, and automated testing.
  • Analyse business and functional requirements, user stories, and technical specifications to create comprehensive test scenarios and test cases.
  • Lead testability discussions during requirements refinement, ensuring acceptance criteria are clear, measurable, and testable.
  • Execute functional, regression, integration, system, and user acceptance testing.
  • Validate complex workflows, data processing, and business-critical financial transactions.
  • Define risk-based testing strategies and determine the appropriate level of verification for each feature.
  • Identify, document, reproduce, and track defects using JIRA and other defect management tools.
  • Perform detailed regression testing ahead of major deployments and releases.
  • Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.
  • Provide clear and consistent reporting on testing progress, risks, and release readiness.
  • Assist with release documentation, user manuals, and client-facing release notes.
  • Drive continuous improvements to QA processes, testing standards, and AI-assisted delivery practices.
  • Mentor QA engineers, provide technical guidance, and help establish high testing standards across the team.
  • Review automated tests critically to ensure they provide meaningful coverage and accurately validate business requirements before release.


Requirements

  • Strong experience as a Senior QA Engineer, Senior Test Analyst, or Test Lead, owning the testing approach for complex projects or workstreams.
  • Excellent understanding of software testing methodologies, risk-based testing, and QA best practices.
  • Experience defining test strategies, leading risk-based testing, and making release readiness or testing sign-off decisions.
  • Experience reviewing requirements for testability, facilitating requirement discussions (e.g. Three Amigos), and defining comprehensive test strategies.
  • Experience building and maintaining automated regression and API test suites using tools such as Postman, Selenium, Playwright, or Katalon.
  • Ability to read and review automated test code and validate test coverage.
  • Ability to critically evaluate automated tests, identify gaps in coverage, and challenge whether the tests truly validate business requirements.
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, Agile delivery environments, and making evidence-based release recommendations.
  • Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar test management and defect tracking tools.
  • Experience documenting business processes or system functionality for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience within regulated or enterprise-scale environments is a plus.
  • Experience with AI-assisted software delivery, reviewing AI-generated tests, or testing AI-enabled features would be a strong advantage.
  • ISTQB Advanced certification.


What you’ll get in return

  • Salary: Starting from €5000 gross/month, depending on your experience (full-time only).
  • Career Growth: Accelerate your professional journey by working with cutting-edge technologies in a truly global environment.
  • Holidays: Enjoy extra vacation days to recharge and unwind.
  • Flexibility: Benefit from hybrid working options for a healthy work-life balance.
  • Workplace: A modern, pet-friendly office equipped with parking and plenty of snacks to keep you fueled and productive.
  • High-Spec Hardware: Brand-new, high-performance equipment provided to support your work from day one.
  • Team Environment: A dynamic, collaborative, and friendly working atmosphere.
  • Perks: Enjoy additional health insurance, plan for the future with 3rd-pillar pension benefits, and perform at your best with high-spec hardware.
